about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: First byte of WS-DATE-TIME's VALUE image is WS-CURDATE-YEAR(1:1); POPULATE-HEADER-INFO's MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA overwrites it before any WS-CURDATE-* field is read, and nothing reads WS-DATE-TIME earlier.

IMAGE of DFHCOMMAREA (one chunk of its 32767-byte VALUE image): COSGN00C's PROCEDURE DIVISION never references DFHCOMMAREA (it reads only EIBCALEN); the area's bytes are read only by fill_CarddemoCommarea through caBack, into the task's COMMAREA object, which for a terminal task (CC00, never LINKed) is not observable: CICS discards it at RETURN, and equivalence_cics.linked_result drops it (the RETURN / XCTL COMMAREA is out_'s copy of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA).
